llm_response.reason: The website displays classic scam characteristics including urgency tactics (countdown timer), the promise of free in-game items for PUBG Mobile (a well-known game), requests for social login, no verifiable business or contact information, mimicking a legitimate brand, and targeting psychological weaknesses for free/rare items. There is no legitimate company detail or support visible; the site aims to steal login credentials. This fits the 'Fake Online Shopping' scam category, specifically targeting gaming users.
